question: Can candidate-level shared-policy GRPO improve de novo Raw@1 while preserving editing and outperforming matched continued SFT?

training.group_use: training exploration and within-prompt advantage estimation only
training.objective: candidate-level expected reward aligned with Raw@1
training.de_novo_schedule: five groups for each arity 2p through 7p
training.edit_schedule: three groups for each exact registered editing task
training.reference_kl: token-level sampled k3 against frozen input adapter
training.advantage: per-prompt per-channel group z-score then aggregate and renormalize
training.gradient_merge: equal-norm bisector of separately differentiated mode losses

development_selection.selection: prefer safety-eligible checkpoints, then maximize de novo strict delta, then maximin strict delta, then earlier step

heldout_confirmation.evaluation: one sampled candidate per condition, temperature 0.8, top_p 0.95
heldout_confirmation.uncertainty: paired task-stratified bootstrap with 2000 replicates, reported but not used to change the locked point-estimate gate
